Stop losing your best AI prompts in saved posts and forgotten notes. 👀

There’s a free, open-source AI prompt library called prompts.chat that brings thousands of community prompts, ready-made AI skills, and complete workflows into one place.

If you use AI for content creation, writing, coding, design, or research, this gives you a starting point without having to build every prompt from scratch.
